questions.stem: The average age of \(15\) students in a class is \(22\) years. If \(5\) new students with an average age of \(18\) years join the class, what will be the new average age of all students?
questions.keySolution:
Total age of \(15\) students = \(15 \times 22 = 330\) years
Total age of \(5\) new students = \(5 \times 18 = 90\) years
Total students = \(15 + 5 = 20\)
New average = \(\frac{330 + 90}{20} = \frac{420}{20} = 21\) years

questions.stem: In a group of \(20\) people, the average weight is \(65\) kg. If \(4\) people with an average weight of \(70\) kg leave the group, what is the new average weight?
questions.keySolution:
Total weight of \(20\) people = \(20 \times 65 = 1300\) kg
Weight of \(4\) people leaving = \(4 \times 70 = 280\) kg
Remaining people = \(20 - 4 = 16\)
New average = \(\frac{1300 - 280}{16} = \frac{1020}{16} = 63.75\) kg

questions.stem: The average marks of \(30\) students in a test is \(75\). The average of the first \(15\) students is \(70\) and that of the next \(10\) students is \(85\). What is the average marks of the remaining \(5\) students?
questions.keySolution:
Total marks of \(30\) students = \(30 \times 75 = 2250\)
Marks of first \(15\) students = \(15 \times 70 = 1050\)
Marks of next \(10\) students = \(10 \times 85 = 850\)
Marks of remaining \(5\) students = \(2250 - 1050 - 850 = 350\)
Average of remaining \(5\) students = \(\frac{350}{5} = 70\)

questions.stem: A cricket team has \(11\) players with an average age of \(28\) years. If the captain, who is \(32\) years old, is replaced by a new player, the average age becomes \(27\) years. What is the age of the new player?
questions.keySolution:
Total age of \(11\) players = \(11 \times 28 = 308\) years
After replacement, total age = \(11 \times 27 = 297\) years
Age of new player = \(297 - (308 - 32) = 297 - 276 = 21\) years

questions.stem: The average height of \(25\) students is \(160\) cm. If \(5\) students with an average height of \(170\) cm join and \(3\) students with an average height of \(150\) cm leave, what is the new average height?
questions.keySolution:
Total height of \(25\) students = \(25 \times 160 = 4000\) cm
Height added by \(5\) new students = \(5 \times 170 = 850\) cm
Height removed by \(3\) leaving students = \(3 \times 150 = 450\) cm
New total height = \(4000 + 850 - 450 = 4400\) cm
New number of students = \(25 + 5 - 3 = 27\)
New average = \(\frac{4400}{27} = 162.96\) cm

questions.stem: In a company, the average salary of \(40\) employees is Rs. \(\,25000\). If \(10\) employees with an average salary of Rs. \(\,30000\) resign, what will be the average salary of the remaining employees?
questions.keySolution:
Total salary of \(40\) employees = \(40 \times 25000 = 1000000\)
Salary of \(10\) resigning employees = \(10 \times 30000 = 300000\)
Remaining employees = \(40 - 10 = 30\)
New average = \(\frac{1000000 - 300000}{30} = \frac{700000}{30} = 23333.33\)

questions.stem: The average score of \(12\) batsmen is \(45\) runs. If the scores of the first \(6\) batsmen average \(40\) runs and the next \(4\) batsmen average \(50\) runs, what is the average score of the last \(2\) batsmen?
questions.keySolution:
Total score of \(12\) batsmen = \(12 \times 45 = 540\) runs
Score of first \(6\) batsmen = \(6 \times 40 = 240\) runs
Score of next \(4\) batsmen = \(4 \times 50 = 200\) runs
Score of last \(2\) batsmen = \(540 - 240 - 200 = 100\) runs
Average of last \(2\) batsmen = \(\frac{100}{2} = 50\) runs

questions.stem: A group of \(8\) friends has an average age of \(24\) years. Two friends leave the group and \(3\) new friends with ages \(20\), \(22\), and \(26\) years join. What is the new average age?
questions.keySolution:
Total age of \(8\) friends = \(8 \times 24 = 192\) years
Assuming the \(2\) friends leaving had average age \(24\): \(2 \times 24 = 48\) years
Age of \(3\) new friends = \(20 + 22 + 26 = 68\) years
New total age = \(192 - 48 + 68 = 212\) years
Remaining friends = \(8 - 2 + 3 = 9\)
New average = \(\frac{212}{9} = 23.56\) years

questions.stem: The average marks of \(50\) students in Mathematics is \(65\). The average marks of \(30\) students among them is \(70\). What is the average marks of the remaining \(20\) students?
questions.keySolution:
Total marks of \(50\) students = \(50 \times 65 = 3250\)
Marks of \(30\) students = \(30 \times 70 = 2100\)
Marks of remaining \(20\) students = \(3250 - 2100 = 1150\)
Average of remaining \(20\) students = \(\frac{1150}{20} = 57.5\)

questions.stem: In a school, the average weight of \(35\) students in class A is \(45\) kg and the average weight of \(25\) students in class B is \(55\) kg. What is the combined average weight of all students?
questions.keySolution:
Total weight of class A = \(35 \times 45 = 1575\) kg
Total weight of class B = \(25 \times 55 = 1375\) kg
Total students = \(35 + 25 = 60\)
Combined average = \(\frac{1575 + 1375}{60} = \frac{2950}{60} = 49.17\) kg

questions.stem: The average of \(20\) numbers is \(85\). If \(5\) numbers with an average of \(90\) are removed and \(3\) numbers with an average of \(75\) are added, what is the new average?
questions.keySolution:
Sum of \(20\) numbers = \(20 \times 85 = 1700\)
Sum of \(5\) removed numbers = \(5 \times 90 = 450\)
Sum of \(3\) added numbers = \(3 \times 75 = 225\)
New sum = \(1700 - 450 + 225 = 1475\)
New count = \(20 - 5 + 3 = 18\)
New average = \(\frac{1475}{18} = 81.94\)

questions.stem: A team of \(15\) players has an average score of \(72\) points. If \(3\) players with scores \(80\), \(85\), and \(90\) are replaced by \(3\) new players with scores \(60\), \(65\), and \(70\), what is the new average?
questions.keySolution:
Total score of \(15\) players = \(15 \times 72 = 1080\) points
Score of \(3\) leaving players = \(80 + 85 + 90 = 255\) points
Score of \(3\) new players = \(60 + 65 + 70 = 195\) points
New total = \(1080 - 255 + 195 = 1020\) points
New average = \(\frac{1020}{15} = 68\) points

questions.stem: The average income of \(12\) families in a locality is Rs. \(\,18000\). If \(4\) more families with an average income of Rs. \(\,22000\) move to the locality, what will be the new average income?
questions.keySolution:
Total income of \(12\) families = \(12 \times 18000 = 216000\)
Total income of \(4\) new families = \(4 \times 22000 = 88000\)
Total families = \(12 + 4 = 16\)
New average = \(\frac{216000 + 88000}{16} = \frac{304000}{16} = 19000\)

questions.stem: In a group of \(18\) students, the average marks in English is \(76\). The average marks of the first \(10\) students is \(72\) and that of the last \(10\) students is \(82\). What are the marks obtained by the \(9\)th and \(10\)th students together?
questions.keySolution:
Total marks of \(18\) students = \(18 \times 76 = 1368\)
Marks of first \(10\) students = \(10 \times 72 = 720\)
Marks of last \(10\) students = \(10 \times 82 = 820\)
Marks of \(9\)th and \(10\)th students = \(720 + 820 - 1368 = 172\)

questions.stem: The average age of \(6\) family members is \(30\) years. If the youngest member is \(8\) years old, what was the average age of the family \(4\) years ago?
questions.keySolution:
Current total age = \(6 \times 30 = 180\) years
Four years ago, total age = \(180 - (6 \times 4) = 180 - 24 = 156\) years
Average age \(4\) years ago = \(\frac{156}{6} = 26\) years

questions.stem: A class has \(25\) students with an average height of \(155\) cm. If \(5\) students with heights \(160\), \(162\), \(158\), \(165\), and \(170\) cm join the class, what is the new average height?
questions.keySolution:
Total height of \(25\) students = \(25 \times 155 = 3875\) cm
Height of \(5\) new students = \(160 + 162 + 158 + 165 + 170 = 815\) cm
Total students = \(25 + 5 = 30\)
New average = \(\frac{3875 + 815}{30} = \frac{4690}{30} = 156.33\) cm

questions.stem: The average weight of \(16\) boys is \(65\) kg and the average weight of \(24\) girls is \(55\) kg. What is the average weight of the entire group?
questions.keySolution:
Total weight of \(16\) boys = \(16 \times 65 = 1040\) kg
Total weight of \(24\) girls = \(24 \times 55 = 1320\) kg
Total students = \(16 + 24 = 40\)
Average weight = \(\frac{1040 + 1320}{40} = \frac{2360}{40} = 59\) kg

questions.stem: In a factory, \(20\) workers have an average daily wage of Rs. \(\,400\). If \(5\) workers with an average wage of Rs. \(\,500\) leave and \(8\) workers with an average wage of Rs. \(\,350\) join, what is the new average daily wage?
questions.keySolution:
Total wage of \(20\) workers = \(20 \times 400 = 8000\)
Wage of \(5\) leaving workers = \(5 \times 500 = 2500\)
Wage of \(8\) joining workers = \(8 \times 350 = 2800\)
New total wage = \(8000 - 2500 + 2800 = 8300\)
New number of workers = \(20 - 5 + 8 = 23\)
New average = \(\frac{8300}{23} = 360.87\)

questions.stem: The average score of \(14\) students in a quiz is \(38\) points. If the teacher adds her score of \(95\) points to calculate the class average, what becomes the new average?
questions.keySolution:
Total score of \(14\) students = \(14 \times 38 = 532\) points
Total score including teacher = \(532 + 95 = 627\) points
Total people = \(14 + 1 = 15\)
New average = \(\frac{627}{15} = 41.8\) points

questions.stem: A group of \(10\) friends has an average monthly expenditure of Rs. \(\,8000\). If \(3\) friends leave the group, and their average expenditure was Rs. \(\,9500\), what is the average expenditure of the remaining friends?
questions.keySolution:
Total expenditure of \(10\) friends = \(10 \times 8000 = 80000\)
Expenditure of \(3\) leaving friends = \(3 \times 9500 = 28500\)
Expenditure of remaining \(7\) friends = \(80000 - 28500 = 51500\)
Average expenditure of remaining friends = \(\frac{51500}{7} = 7357.14\)

questions.stem: In a group of \(30\) people, the average age is \(35\) years. \(10\) people with an average age of \(40\) years leave and \(15\) people with an average age of \(28\) years join. What is the new average age?
questions.keySolution:
Total age of \(30\) people = \(30 \times 35 = 1050\) years
Age of \(10\) leaving people = \(10 \times 40 = 400\) years
Age of \(15\) joining people = \(15 \times 28 = 420\) years
New total age = \(1050 - 400 + 420 = 1070\) years
New number of people = \(30 - 10 + 15 = 35\)
New average = \(\frac{1070}{35} = 30.57\) years

questions.stem: The average marks of \(40\) students in Physics is \(68\). The average marks of \(25\) students among them is \(72\) and that of \(10\) students is \(65\). What is the average marks of the remaining \(5\) students?
questions.keySolution:
Total marks of \(40\) students = \(40 \times 68 = 2720\)
Marks of \(25\) students = \(25 \times 72 = 1800\)
Marks of \(10\) students = \(10 \times 65 = 650\)
Marks of remaining \(5\) students = \(2720 - 1800 - 650 = 270\)
Average of remaining \(5\) students = \(\frac{270}{5} = 54\)

questions.stem: A library has \(18\) sections with an average of \(420\) books per section. If \(3\) sections with \(350\), \(380\), and \(400\) books respectively are removed, what is the average number of books in the remaining sections?
questions.keySolution:
Total books in \(18\) sections = \(18 \times 420 = 7560\)
Books in \(3\) removed sections = \(350 + 380 + 400 = 1130\)
Books in remaining \(15\) sections = \(7560 - 1130 = 6430\)
Average in remaining sections = \(\frac{6430}{15} = 428.67\) books

questions.stem: The average temperature recorded by \(12\) weather stations is \(26°C\). If \(4\) stations recording \(24°C\), \(28°C\), \(22°C\), and \(30°C\) are excluded, what is the average temperature of the remaining stations?
questions.keySolution:
Total temperature of \(12\) stations = \(12 \times 26 = 312°C\)
Temperature of \(4\) excluded stations = \(24 + 28 + 22 + 30 = 104°C\)
Temperature of remaining \(8\) stations = \(312 - 104 = 208°C\)
Average of remaining stations = \(\frac{208}{8} = 26°C\)

questions.stem: A company has \(50\) employees with an average experience of \(8\) years. \(10\) senior employees with an average experience of \(15\) years retire. If \(15\) fresh graduates with \(0\) years experience join, what is the new average experience?
questions.keySolution:
Total experience of \(50\) employees = \(50 \times 8 = 400\) years
Experience of \(10\) retiring employees = \(10 \times 15 = 150\) years
Experience of \(15\) new employees = \(15 \times 0 = 0\) years
New total experience = \(400 - 150 + 0 = 250\) years
New number of employees = \(50 - 10 + 15 = 55\)
New average = \(\frac{250}{55} = 4.55\) years

questions.stem: In a batch of \(28\) students, the average marks in Chemistry is \(74\). If the marks of \(4\) students are \(82\), \(78\), \(85\), and \(79\) respectively, what is the average marks of the remaining \(24\) students?
questions.keySolution:
Total marks of \(28\) students = \(28 \times 74 = 2072\)
Marks of \(4\) students = \(82 + 78 + 85 + 79 = 324\)
Marks of remaining \(24\) students = \(2072 - 324 = 1748\)
Average of remaining \(24\) students = \(\frac{1748}{24} = 72.83\)

questions.stem: The average production of a factory for \(15\) days is \(250\) units per day. If the production for the first \(8\) days averages \(230\) units per day, what must be the average production for the remaining \(7\) days?
questions.keySolution:
Total production for \(15\) days = \(15 \times 250 = 3750\) units
Production for first \(8\) days = \(8 \times 230 = 1840\) units
Production for remaining \(7\) days = \(3750 - 1840 = 1910\) units
Average for remaining \(7\) days = \(\frac{1910}{7} = 272.86\) units

questions.stem: A cricket team's average score in \(10\) matches is \(185\) runs. In \(6\) matches, they scored an average of \(200\) runs. What was their average score in the remaining \(4\) matches?
questions.keySolution:
Total score in \(10\) matches = \(10 \times 185 = 1850\) runs
Score in \(6\) matches = \(6 \times 200 = 1200\) runs
Score in remaining \(4\) matches = \(1850 - 1200 = 650\) runs
Average in remaining \(4\) matches = \(\frac{650}{4} = 162.5\) runs

questions.stem: The average price of \(20\) items in a store is Rs. \(\,350\). If \(5\) items with prices Rs. \(\,400\), Rs. \(\,420\), Rs. \(\,380\), Rs. \(\,450\), and Rs. \(\,390\) are returned, what is the new average price?
questions.keySolution:
Total price of \(20\) items = \(20 \times 350 = 7000\)
Price of \(5\) returned items = \(400 + 420 + 380 + 450 + 390 = 2040\)
Price of remaining \(15\) items = \(7000 - 2040 = 4960\)
New average price = \(\frac{4960}{15} = 330.67\)

questions.stem: A group of \(22\) people has an average monthly income of Rs. \(\,28000\). If \(6\) people with an average income of Rs. \(\,35000\) leave and \(4\) people with an average income of Rs. \(\,25000\) join, what is the new average income?
questions.keySolution:
Total income of \(22\) people = \(22 \times 28000 = 616000\)
Income of \(6\) leaving people = \(6 \times 35000 = 210000\)
Income of \(4\) joining people = \(4 \times 25000 = 100000\)
New total income = \(616000 - 210000 + 100000 = 506000\)
New number of people = \(22 - 6 + 4 = 20\)
New average = \(\frac{506000}{20} = 25300\)

questions.stem: The average height of \(16\) basketball players is \(185\) cm. The average height of \(10\) players among them is \(180\) cm. What is the average height of the remaining \(6\) players?
questions.keySolution:
Total height of \(16\) players = \(16 \times 185 = 2960\) cm
Height of \(10\) players = \(10 \times 180 = 1800\) cm
Height of remaining \(6\) players = \(2960 - 1800 = 1160\) cm
Average height of remaining \(6\) players = \(\frac{1160}{6} = 193.33\) cm

questions.stem: In a tournament, \(24\) teams have an average score of \(78\) points. If \(8\) teams with an average score of \(85\) points are disqualified, what is the average score of the remaining teams?
questions.keySolution:
Total score of \(24\) teams = \(24 \times 78 = 1872\) points
Score of \(8\) disqualified teams = \(8 \times 85 = 680\) points
Score of remaining \(16\) teams = \(1872 - 680 = 1192\) points
Average of remaining teams = \(\frac{1192}{16} = 74.5\) points

questions.stem: The average marks of \(35\) students is \(82\). If \(5\) students with marks \(88\), \(92\), \(76\), \(94\), and \(85\) transfer to another school, what is the new average?
questions.keySolution:
Total marks of \(35\) students = \(35 \times 82 = 2870\)
Marks of \(5\) transferring students = \(88 + 92 + 76 + 94 + 85 = 435\)
Marks of remaining \(30\) students = \(2870 - 435 = 2435\)
New average = \(\frac{2435}{30} = 81.17\)

questions.stem: A school has \(45\) teachers with an average age of \(38\) years. \(15\) senior teachers with an average age of \(48\) years retire and \(18\) young teachers with an average age of \(26\) years join. What is the new average age?
questions.keySolution:
Total age of \(45\) teachers = \(45 \times 38 = 1710\) years
Age of \(15\) retiring teachers = \(15 \times 48 = 720\) years
Age of \(18\) joining teachers = \(18 \times 26 = 468\) years
New total age = \(1710 - 720 + 468 = 1458\) years
New number of teachers = \(45 - 15 + 18 = 48\)
New average = \(\frac{1458}{48} = 30.375\) years

questions.stem: The average rainfall in \(12\) districts of a state is \(85\) cm. The average rainfall in \(7\) districts is \(92\) cm and in \(3\) districts is \(78\) cm. What is the average rainfall in the remaining \(2\) districts?
questions.keySolution:
Total rainfall in \(12\) districts = \(12 \times 85 = 1020\) cm
Rainfall in \(7\) districts = \(7 \times 92 = 644\) cm
Rainfall in \(3\) districts = \(3 \times 78 = 234\) cm
Rainfall in remaining \(2\) districts = \(1020 - 644 - 234 = 142\) cm
Average in remaining \(2\) districts = \(\frac{142}{2} = 71\) cm

questions.stem: A gym has \(32\) members with an average monthly fee of Rs. \(\,1200\). If \(8\) premium members paying Rs. \(\,1800\) each cancel their memberships, what is the new average fee?
questions.keySolution:
Total fee of \(32\) members = \(32 \times 1200 = 38400\)
Fee of \(8\) canceling members = \(8 \times 1800 = 14400\)
Fee of remaining \(24\) members = \(38400 - 14400 = 24000\)
New average fee = \(\frac{24000}{24} = 1000\)

questions.stem: The average speed of \(18\) vehicles on a highway is \(75\) km/h. If \(6\) vehicles traveling at \(90\) km/h exit the highway and \(4\) vehicles traveling at \(60\) km/h enter, what is the new average speed?
questions.keySolution:
Total speed of \(18\) vehicles = \(18 \times 75 = 1350\) km/h
Speed of \(6\) exiting vehicles = \(6 \times 90 = 540\) km/h
Speed of \(4\) entering vehicles = \(4 \times 60 = 240\) km/h
New total speed = \(1350 - 540 + 240 = 1050\) km/h
New number of vehicles = \(18 - 6 + 4 = 16\)
New average = \(\frac{1050}{16} = 65.625\) km/h

questions.stem: In a group of \(26\) students, the average marks in Biology is \(77\). The average of the first \(14\) students is \(74\) and the average of the last \(16\) students is \(81\). What is the sum of marks of the \(11\)th, \(12\)th, \(13\)th, and \(14\)th students?
questions.keySolution:
Total marks of \(26\) students = \(26 \times 77 = 2002\)
Marks of first \(14\) students = \(14 \times 74 = 1036\)
Marks of last \(16\) students = \(16 \times 81 = 1296\)
Overlapping marks (11th to 14th) = \(1036 + 1296 - 2002 = 330\)

questions.stem: A company's \(60\) employees have an average salary of Rs. \(\,32000\). The average salary of \(40\) junior employees is Rs. \(\,28000\). What is the average salary of the remaining \(20\) senior employees?
questions.keySolution:
Total salary of \(60\) employees = \(60 \times 32000 = 1920000\)
Salary of \(40\) junior employees = \(40 \times 28000 = 1120000\)
Salary of \(20\) senior employees = \(1920000 - 1120000 = 800000\)
Average salary of senior employees = \(\frac{800000}{20} = 40000\)

questions.stem: The average weight of \(14\) packages is \(23.5\) kg. If \(4\) packages weighing \(25\) kg, \(22\) kg, \(28\) kg, and \(21\) kg are removed, what is the new average weight?
questions.keySolution:
Total weight of \(14\) packages = \(14 \times 23.5 = 329\) kg
Weight of \(4\) removed packages = \(25 + 22 + 28 + 21 = 96\) kg
Weight of remaining \(10\) packages = \(329 - 96 = 233\) kg
New average = \(\frac{233}{10} = 23.3\) kg

questions.stem: A restaurant serves \(36\) customers with an average bill of Rs. \(\,450\). If \(12\) customers with bills averaging Rs. \(\,600\) leave without paying and \(8\) new customers with an average bill of Rs. \(\,350\) arrive, what is the new average bill?
questions.keySolution:
Total bill of \(36\) customers = \(36 \times 450 = 16200\)
Bill of \(12\) leaving customers = \(12 \times 600 = 7200\)
Bill of \(8\) new customers = \(8 \times 350 = 2800\)
New total bill = \(16200 - 7200 + 2800 = 11800\)
New number of customers = \(36 - 12 + 8 = 32\)
New average = \(\frac{11800}{32} = 368.75\)

questions.stem: In a survey, \(50\) people reported an average monthly expense of Rs. \(\,15000\). The survey found that \(30\) people spend an average of Rs. \(\,12000\) monthly. What is the average monthly expense of the remaining \(20\) people?
questions.keySolution:
Total expense of \(50\) people = \(50 \times 15000 = 750000\)
Expense of \(30\) people = \(30 \times 12000 = 360000\)
Expense of remaining \(20\) people = \(750000 - 360000 = 390000\)
Average expense of remaining \(20\) people = \(\frac{390000}{20} = 19500\)

questions.stem: The average score of \(42\) participants in a quiz is \(68\) points. If \(6\) participants with scores of \(75\), \(72\), \(78\), \(80\), \(76\), and \(74\) points withdraw, what is the new average score?
questions.keySolution:
Total score of \(42\) participants = \(42 \times 68 = 2856\) points
Score of \(6\) withdrawing participants = \(75 + 72 + 78 + 80 + 76 + 74 = 455\) points
Score of remaining \(36\) participants = \(2856 - 455 = 2401\) points
New average = \(\frac{2401}{36} = 66.69\) points

questions.stem: A research group has \(28\) members with an average research experience of \(12\) years. If \(8\) senior members with \(20\) years average experience leave and \(10\) junior members with \(5\) years average experience join, what is the new average experience?
questions.keySolution:
Total experience of \(28\) members = \(28 \times 12 = 336\) years
Experience of \(8\) leaving members = \(8 \times 20 = 160\) years
Experience of \(10\) joining members = \(10 \times 5 = 50\) years
New total experience = \(336 - 160 + 50 = 226\) years
New number of members = \(28 - 8 + 10 = 30\)
New average = \(\frac{226}{30} = 7.53\) years

questions.stem: The average marks of \(55\) students in a college is \(72\). The average marks of \(25\) students from Arts stream is \(68\) and \(20\) students from Science stream is \(78\). What is the average marks of the remaining \(10\) students from Commerce stream?
questions.keySolution:
Total marks of \(55\) students = \(55 \times 72 = 3960\)
Marks of \(25\) Arts students = \(25 \times 68 = 1700\)
Marks of \(20\) Science students = \(20 \times 78 = 1560\)
Marks of \(10\) Commerce students = \(3960 - 1700 - 1560 = 700\)
Average marks of Commerce students = \(\frac{700}{10} = 70\)
